title: The derived pullback of module objects is strong monoidal
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes. Write $\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$ for module objects over the pulled-back ring on the pro-étale site of $T$, $f^*$ for the (exact, monoidal) pullback of module objects, $Lf^*$ for its left derived functor and $\otimes^L$ for the derived tensor product [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]; $Q_h\colon K(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})\to D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$ is the localization of the homotopy category. The derived pullback $Lf^*\colon D(\Mod_{\Lambda_Y})\to D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ with tensorator the inverse of the comparison isomorphism $Lf^*(K\otimes^LL)\cong Lf^*K\otimes^LLf^*L$ and unit comparison $Lf^*\mathbb 1\cong\mathbb 1$ (the counit followed by the unit comparison of $f^*$) satisfies the associativity and the two unitality axioms of a monoidal functor; hence $Lf^*$ is strong monoidal.

proof.text: Put $\mathcal C_T=\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$, $F=f^*$, $E=Lf^*$, and $Q_T=Q_h$ on $T=X,Y$. These are exactly the full composite module pullback and its total unbounded left derived functor of [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], with the relative derived tensors of [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Apply [new-proetale-derived-module-pullback-monoidal] to the given commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ and the given scheme morphism $f$. Its statement holds for arbitrary $\Lambda,f$ and unbounded complexes, so no finiteness, flatness of coefficients, or boundedness assumption is added. It supplies a strong monoidal structure on this same $E$, with invertible comonoidal comparison $\delta$, characterized by its specified tensor counits. We next identify those maps with the prescribed maps; mere existence of some monoidal structure would not suffice.

source.place: Two-variable derived tensor and descent of constraints, specialized through the existing canonical pro-etale module-pullback theorem.

proof.text:
Write $F_h$ for termwise pullback on homotopy complexes, $\gamma_A:EQ_YA\to Q_XF_hA$ for the derived counit, $\mu_T$ for the localization tensorator, and $b_{A,B}:F_hA\otimes F_hB\xrightarrow{\sim}F_h(A\otimes B)$ for the ordinary total-complex tensorator. By [def-sfb-upper-star-tensor-counit], the right counit used to define $m$ is
$$r_{A,B}=Q_X(b_{A,B})\circ\mu_{X;F_hA,F_hB}\circ(\gamma_A\otimes\gamma_B).$$
By [def-sfb-derived-pullback-tensor-left-counit], its left counit is
$$l_{A,B}=\gamma_{A\otimes B}\circ E(\mu_{Y;A,B}).$$
These are literally the two formulas in the statement of [new-proetale-derived-module-pullback-monoidal]. That statement exhibits both source bifunctors as total left derived bifunctors and characterizes $\delta$ by $r_{A,B}\circ\delta_{Q_YA,Q_YB}=l_{A,B}$. The comparison $m$ is the universal comparison for these same counits. Uniqueness of that universal comparison therefore gives $m=\delta$ as natural transformations of bifunctors, not merely an unspecified isomorphism between their values. Consequently the strong tensorator supplied in step 1 is exactly $m^{-1}$.

source.place: Two-variable left derived universal property; comparison characterized by the counit equation.

proof.text:
Let $I_T=\Lambda_T[0]$ and let $j:F_hI_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}I_X$ be the ordinary unit comparison in degree zero. The unit clause of [new-proetale-derived-module-pullback-monoidal] says that the inverse unit of its strong monoidal structure is exactly
$$c=Q_X(j)\circ\gamma_{I_Y}:E\mathbf1_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_X,$$
using the native identifications $Q_TI_T=\mathbf1_T$. This is the counit followed by the unit comparison of $f^*$ specified in the statement. Thus its forward unit is exactly $c^{-1}$, and step 1's strong structure has both of the prescribed maps.

noncomputable instance monoidal_leftDerivedUpperStar : L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧).Monoidal :=
  letI := leftDerivedUpperStarOplaxMonoidal Λ f
  haveI (K L : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))) :
      IsIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧) K L) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso (((leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f).app K).app L))
  haveI : IsIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧)) := by
    rw [leftDerivedUpperStarOplaxMonoidal_η]
    infer_instance
  have hμ (K L : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))) :
      (((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso Λ f).app K).app L).symm =
        (asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧) K L)).symm := by
    ext
    exact (IsIso.inv_eq_of_hom_inv_id
      (((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso Λ f).app K).app L).hom_inv_id).symm
  have hε : (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso Λ f).symm =
      (asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧))).symm := by
    ext
    refine (IsIso.inv_eq_of_hom_inv_id ?_).symm
    rw [leftDerivedUpperStarOplaxMonoidal_η, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.hom_inv_id]
  Functor.CoreMonoidal.toMonoidal
    { εIso := (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso Λ f).symm
      μIso K L := (((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso Λ f).app K).app L).symm
      μIso_hom_natural_left φ L :=
        NatTrans.congr_app ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso Λ f).inv.naturality φ) L
      μIso_hom_natural_right K ψ :=
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso Λ f).inv.app K).naturality ψ
      associativity K L M := by
        rw [hμ, hμ, hμ, hμ]
        exact (Functor.CoreMonoidal.ofOplaxMonoidal L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧)).associativity K L M
      left_unitality K := by
        rw [hμ, hε]
        exact (Functor.CoreMonoidal.ofOplaxMonoidal L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧)).left_unitality K
      right_unitality K := by
        rw [hμ, hε]
        exact (Functor.CoreMonoidal.ofOplaxMonoidal L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧)).right_unitality K }
